basic_details.job_title: Press Council of India ASO Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Assistant Section Officer Posts

age_limit.details: Age relaxation will be provided to eligible reserved-category candidates according to the applicable government rules.

qualification.details: Candidates should possess a graduation degree in any discipline from a recognised university and fulfil the prescribed computer-typing requirement.

salary_details.details: The Assistant Section Officer post carries Pay Level 6. The corresponding pre-revised pay scale is Rs.9,300-34,800 with Grade Pay of Rs.4,200. Other admissible allowances will be provided according to applicable rules.

selection_process: The selection process may include the following stages:
Tier-I Objective Examination Tier-II Descriptive Examination Computer Typing Test Document Verification
how_to_apply: Visit the official Press Council of India website.
Download the detailed notification and prescribed application form.
Fill in the personal, educational and communication details correctly.
Attach self-attested copies of the date-of-birth certificate, educational certificates and other required documents.
Pay the applicable application fee and attach the payment proof.
Check the completed application form carefully.
Send it to the prescribed address so that it reaches the Press Council of India by 26 October 2026.
important_instructions: The application must be submitted in the prescribed format. All supporting certificates should be self-attested. Candidates must ensure that the application reaches PCI within the prescribed period. Applicants should keep a copy of the completed form and supporting documents. Candidates should regularly visit the official PCI website for examination and recruitment updates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Press Council of India ASO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official Press Council of India website. Download the detailed notification and prescribed application form. Fill in the personal, educational and communication details correctly. Attach self-attested copies of the date-of-birth certificate, educational certificates and other required documents. Pay the applicable application fee and attach the payment proof. Check the completed application form carefully. Send it to the prescribed address so that it reaches the Press Council of India by 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in PCI ASO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are three Assistant Section Officer vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the category-wise vacancy distribution?
faq.answer: Two vacancies are available for the Unreserved category and one is reserved for OBC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application should reach the Press Council of India by 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a graduation degree in any discipline and meet the prescribed computer-typing requirement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Assistant Section Officer post?
faq.answer: The prescribed age limit is 20 to 30 years, subject to applicable relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply in offline mode using the prescribed application form.
